title: 12V PARASITIC POWER DRAW ISOLATION
description: Comprehensive 2-prompt pack covering automotive fluid testing and 12V parasitic draw isolation.
content:
PART 2: 12V PARASITIC POWER DRAW ISOLATION
Act as an automotive electrical specialist. Design a step-by-step diagnostic roadmap to identify and trace hidden battery drains bypassing standard module shut-down sleep cycles.

The protocol must verify:
1. Voltage Drop Testing across the fuse blocks layout structure: Detail how to set a digital multimeter to millivolts (mV) and probe the back of the blade fuses without waking up the local controller network.
2. Parasitic Draw thresholds: Detail standard draw baselines, flagging an error alert condition if current draw exceeds {{Max Dark Current Draw mA: 50}} mA after the vehicle enters sleep mode.
3. Common fault isolation order: Provide a prioritized circuit checklist checking aftermarket accessories, glove box or trunk switches, and proximity key modules.
